design_philosophy: The design must feel warm, energetic, and empathetic. Banish all 'sad/boring' pastel tones. We are substituting dull clinical vibes with a vibrant, sunny palette that feels like a fresh morning. We use 'Soft' geometries (rounded corners) paired with 'High Vibrancy' colors to create an empowering space for mothers.

images.description: Vibrant sunrise background for the landing or dashboard greeting. Use this as a subtle background pattern or hero image header to bring extreme positivity.
3D orb icon for Willow AI avatar. Use it in chat interfaces, notification icons, and empty states.
Positive energy texture for section backgrounds or quick action cards.
Journaling related imagery to be used in the Journal & Notes Section headers.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react. Set stroke width to 2 or 2.5 for clear, friendly, and approachable icons.

animation_motion.hover_states: All cards and buttons must have -translate-y-1 and elevated shadow transition-all duration-300.
animation_motion.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion to stagger bento grid items on dashboard entry. Start from opacity 0 and y 20 to opacity 1 and y 0.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='chat-input').
Use Outfit for all headings and Figtree for body text. Install these via Google Fonts in your main CSS file.
Do NOT use a muddy or dull layout. Follow the vibrant color palette strictly to create a warm, energetic, and positive space that directly addresses the user feedback.
Use Shadcn UI but heavily customize the radius to rounded-3xl to make components soft, pill-like, and approachable.
The AI Chat (Willow) should feel distinct from a normal support chat. Use the AI avatar provided and warm gradient bubbles.
Bento grid (dashboard): Ensure strict spacing gaps (gap-6) and optical alignment. The main greeting widget should span multiple columns for emphasis.
